title: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Cebu Leg 3 Review: 32K at SM Seaside

meta_description: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 Cebu Leg 3: September 13 at SM Seaside. 32K, 21K, 10K, 5K from Runrio.
dek: Set for 13 September 2026 at SM Seaside Cebu, this Runrio-produced Sante Barley series leg features the rare 32K distance at Cebu's premier waterfront mall.
verdict: The Sante Barley Trilogy Run Cebu Leg 3 brings the rare 32K distance to SM Seaside — Cebu's premier waterfront shopping complex with views over the Mactan Channel. Produced by Runrio, it also offers standard 21K, 10K, and 5K distances. The 32K is a genuine stepping-stone for marathon aspirants. September in Cebu is the transition into the northeast monsoon. A distinctive Runrio-produced Cebu series leg with an unusual distance option.
